sentences.text:
Or 
This petition under Article 227 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking following relief(s):-
(i) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing to the execution court that the execution case no. Ex.LA.15/2020 filed by the petitioner should be decided within 3 months and the amount of compensation should be given in the ends of justice.
(ii) Any other direction/ orders, which deemed fit and proper looking to the facts and circumstances of the case.
2. It appears that petitioner has filed an execution case for execution of Award passed under the Land Acquisition Act.
It is the case of petitioner that matter is getting delayed without any reasonable cause.
The execution proceedings were initiated in the month of February, 2020 and more than 4 years & 9 months have passed but it has not reached to any logical end.
NEUTRAL

sentences.text: Per contra, petition is vehemently opposed by counsel for the respondents/State.
It is submitted that petitioner has filed only partial order-sheets of the executing Court.
The last order-sheet which has been filed is dated 20/11/2023, according to which, petitioner had not paid process fee.
It is not known as to what has transpired after November, 2023.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

5. The Supreme Court in the case of High Court Bar Association, Allahabad Vs. State of U.P. and Others decided on 29.02.2024 in Criminal Appeal No.3589/2023 has held that Constitutional Courts should not fix the outer limits for the Courts below thereby disturbing their calendar.

entities.text: High Court Bar Association, Allahabad Vs. State of U.P. and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, it was also observed that in exceptional circumstances, such direction can be given.

6. Petitioner has not filed the order-sheets of last one year, therefore it is not known as to whether petitioner is in fault for delay of the proceedings or not because the order-sheet which has been placed on record indicates that petitioner had not paid the process fee.
7.
Under these circumstances, it is difficult for this Court to fix any outer limit for the executing Court to execute the decree.
However, it is observed that it is very easy to obtain a decree but it is very difficult to get it executed.
Unless and until the decree is executed, a paper decree will not come to the rescue of decree holder.

8. Under these circumstances, it is observed that executing Court shall make every endeavor to expedite the execution proceedings.
9.
With aforesaid observation, petition is finally disposed of.

(G.S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE S.M.
